name: Lou Oddo
source:
A mysterious transfer student who enters the academy the same day as Julia.

[spoiler]He's not actually a part of the Oddo family, but a tailor named Quinsea. He's a con artist who tricks noble women for money by dressing up as nobles.[/spoiler]
